name: Inverse Design Algorithm for Voxel-based CGVHs
aliases: Iterative Propagation Algorithm (IPA) for mode conversion
definition: An algorithm to design voxel-based computer-generated volume holograms (CGVHs) that convert N mutually incoherent transverse input modes {un} to N target modes {vn} with a one-to-one mapping, using a finite extent sample in a rectangular coordinate system.
summary: The Inverse Design Algorithm for Voxel-based CGVHs optimizes 3D refractive index distributions to convert input modes into target modes using iterative forward and backward propagation with a local multi-objective criterion.
